Title: Verify the Simple Alert shows its message and closes on OK
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Click 'Simple Alert' 2. Read the alert text 3. Click OK
Expected Result: Alert text is 'I am an alert box!'; the alert closes after OK

Title: Verify the 'New Tab' button opens the target site in a new browser tab
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Click 'New Tab' 2. Switch to the newly opened tab 3. Read its URL 4. Close the new tab and return to the original tab
Expected Result: A new tab opens with pavantestingtools.com; after closing it only the original tab remains

Title: Verify the 'Popup Windows' button opens additional browser windows
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Click 'Popup Windows' 2. Count open windows 3. Close all popup windows
Expected Result: At least one extra window opens; after closing them only the original window remains
